You review the phase decisions of a reinforcement-learning traffic signal controller. For one intersection you receive a textual description of the local traffic condition and the list of admissible phases. Decide which admissible phase a careful traffic engineer would activate, and answer with that phase.

Description fields:
  queue ratio  - queued vehicles / lane storage capacity of the movement
  occupancy    - detector occupancy of the movement in the last interval

A decision is unreasonable if it gives green to a movement that is nearly empty while another movement of the same intersection is close to spillback (queue ratio above 0.8), or if it keeps serving a movement whose queue has already been cleared.

Reply with the phase index only, one integer from the admissible list, and nothing else.
